The shared pathway from Parkinsonian Disorder to the syndrome implies that the drug's effects on the central nervous system may influence the development or progression of the syndrome. However, the evidence is limited to the direct indication links and does not provide direct mechanistic or clinical evidence of a repurposing effect.
